biography.value:
Published alignment: CE/CN.

Description

A crown of cruel horns surrounds the head of this mighty juvenile dragon. Thick scales the color of molten rock cover its long body.

Defense

AC 23, touch 11, flat-footed 21 (+2 dex, +12 natural, -1 size)

hp 126 [192] (12d12+48)

mp 64

Fort +12, Ref +10, Will +15

DR 5/magic; Immune Fire, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Ice 50%

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)

Melee Bite +18 (2d6+10), 2 Claws +18 (1d8+7), 2 Wings +13 (1d6+3), Tail Slap +13 (1d8+10)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (40-ft. cone, 6d10 fire damage, Reflex DC 20 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Fire Roar, Fireball, Healing Flame

Spells Known (FC CL 12th, Concentration +17)

At will - bleed, detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic, torchlight

1st (DC 12) - detonate, fire

2nd (DC 13) - detonate II, elemental resistance, fire II, see invisibility

3rd (DC 14) - detonate III, dispel, fira, fire III, haste

4th (DC 20) - blaze spikes, fire IV, volcanic storm

Statistics

Str 25, Dex 15, Con 19, Int 12, Wis 20, Cha 12

Base Atk +12; CMB +20; CMD 32 (36 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Power Attack, Vital Strike

Skills Appraise +15, Bluff +15, Fly +11, Intimidate +15, Perception +19, Spellcraft +15, Stealth +13

Languages Common, Draconic

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a red dragon roars a fiery cone blast within 30-ft. burst. Any creature within the area of effect takes 10d6 points of fire damage and are inflicted with the Burn status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 21) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

Any creature within the area of effect takes 10d6 points of fire damage and are inflicted with the Burn status effect for 1d6 rounds. description.value: As a standard action within 840 ft., a red dragon generates a searing explosion of flame that detonates with a low roar and deals 5d8 points of fire damage to every creature within the 20-ft.-radius. Every creature caught in the explosion must make a Reflex save (DC 21) to take half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, the red dragon manifests a sacred flame beneath his foe up to 30 feet away, dealing 6d6 points of damage (half holy/fire) and heals himself for half the damage dealt. The target must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 21) to take half damage and the red dragon does not gain any hit points. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

actions.name: Healing Flame

save.description: Half damage and no healing. On failure the caster heals half of the damage actually dealt.

effect: Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, the red dragon manifests a sacred flame beneath his foe up to 30 feet away, dealing 6d6 points of damage (half holy/fire) and heals himself for half the damage dealt. The target must make a successful Fortitude save (DC 21) to take half damage and the red dragon does not gain any hit points. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
Roll once. Half is fire; the remainder is light. Apply each recipient's defenses to its shares.
